summary: Iron County lookout tower that the Forest Fire Lookout Association lists as gone; no other source found on its history.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone; no source describes what, if anything, remains at the site.

evidence.supports: listed as a lookout tower in Iron County at 46.22096, -90.25861, status gone

notes_for_editor: Single source: the FFLA Wisconsin list gives name, county, coordinates and gone status, which match the record. The Central US Wisconsin page has no Moose entry and Wikipedia has no page for it. About two web searches and about six reads, most of them on shared list pages. The story is about 45 words, well under the 120-word floor, because nothing else is on record. A local newspaper or Iron County history search is the next step. Confidence low.
